proposal.expected_benefit: This will ensure that audit and compliance controls are consistently and unambiguously enforced, reducing the risk of contradictions and improving the system's robustness against adversarial scenarios.
proposal.problem: The system's reliance on audit-before-execution and compliance gates may introduce ambiguity in control implementation, leading to potential contradictions in enforcement.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear and explicit enforcement policy for audit and compliance gates to resolve ambiguities and ensure consistent application of controls. This includes defining strict rules for when audit status can override compliance decisions and vice versa, to prevent contradictions in control implementation.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement
verification_tests: Validate that audit and compliance gates are enforced consistently across all scenarios.
Check for contradictions in control implementation during adversarial testing.
